components.css: .ds-steps{display:flex;gap:18px;border-bottom:1px solid #beced9;font-family:'Segoe UI',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-steps a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 0 16px;color:var(--muted,#536777);font-size:12.15px;line-height:1.55;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;white-space:nowrap}.ds-steps a span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:22px;height:22px;border:1px solid #c7d4de;border-radius:50%;font-size:10.5px}.ds-steps a:hover{color:var(--teal-dark,#00645f)}.ds-steps a[aria-current]{color:var(--teal-dark,#00645f);border-bottom-color:var(--teal,#007f7a);font-weight:650}.ds-steps a[aria-current] span{color:white;background:var(--teal,#007f7a);border-color:var(--teal,#007f7a)}.ds-steps a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1a78bb;outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:1180px){.ds-steps{gap:14px}.ds-steps a{font-size:11.1px;gap:6px}}@media(max-width:740px){.ds-steps{overflow-x:auto;gap:20px;padding:0 2px}.ds-steps a{font-size:12px;padding-top:10px}}

narrative.overview:
PermitPath is a restrained operational workspace: navy navigation frames a light paper canvas, teal identifies actions, and original SVG blueprint sheets make the project tangible. Its visual authority is the built application, not a generated concept or marketing composition.

Compact system typography, fine dividers and visibly labeled states support scanning and editing. The confirmed direction is task-first and responsive; illustration describes a concept without implying engineering certification or permit approval.
keyCharacteristics: Navy navigation, paper canvas and teal actions.
Compact system typography with a modest heading ramp.
Original blueprints presented as labeled working sheets.
Text-backed statuses and explicit form feedback.
Responsive navigation and drawing-first mobile editing.

rules.name: The Text-Backed Status Rule
rules.body: A check status combines color with its label and a checkmark, exclamation mark or question mark; color alone never explains the result.

rules.name: The Keep-the-Task-Visible Rule
rules.body: Narrow screens retain labeled navigation and scrollable walkthrough steps; the editor places its live drawing before the form rather than squeezing both into desktop columns.

rules.name: The Concept-Not-Certification Rule
rules.body: Preserve the drawing's concept label and adjacent limitations: symbolic posts are not engineered spacing, and illustrated fixtures are not a clearance calculation.

dos: **Do** preserve the pinned navy, teal, mint and paper palette.
**Do** keep system typography, visible keyboard focus and labeled native controls.
**Do** pair check colors with labels and symbols.
**Do** keep original blueprints and their concept limitations together.
**Do** retain responsive sidebar names, scrollable steps and drawing-first mobile editing.
donts: **Don't** portray a satisfied check or selected strategy as permit approval.
**Don't** substitute decorative concept art for the original working SVG diagrams.
**Don't** hide invalid dimensions behind a plausible default drawing.
